summary: Validated the AMASS Public Property Map Correction (Redfin-style rebuild). Backend spot-check confirmed /api/properties reads ONLY from db.properties (server.py:414), never surfaces properties_geo/property_candidates, and never leaks _id. Phase-D regression: 134 passed · 1 skipped (1 flaky test 'test_concurrent_limit_returns_429' failed on parallel run at 165s timeout, passed cleanly on isolated re-run — pre-existing race-condition flake, not caused by this iteration). Frontend verified: (a) legend sheet now shows 'Property Type Legend' with exactly 9 items — testIDs legend-residential/apartment/estate/land/commercial/industrial/hospitality/institutional/other (old sale/rent/commercial/premium legend fully removed); (b) marker testIDs are the new marker-{slug} form (verified marker-residential rendered with compact label '₦145M'); (c) no legacy marker-sale / marker-rent / marker-premium / marker-commercial testIDs anywhere in /app/frontend; (d) NO calls to /api/admin/discovery/* observed from the public map/home; (e) admin /admin/discovery page remains intact (Property Discovery hub, 2 pending duplicate candidates, search form, mock-mode banner); (f) PropertyCard row variant contains rowLeftAccent bar bound to propertyTypeColor(property_type) (code review); (g) MapDockedCard renders a typeChip with a coloured dot + capitalised property_type text, and a 'Price on Request' branch when price is 0/null (code review). formatMarkerPrice helper correctly emits ₦{amount}, ₦{amount}/yr for rent, ₦{amount}/mo for shortlet, and 'Price on Request' for missing/invalid price. IMPORTANT: react-native-maps renders a STATIC placeholder on Expo web preview ('Interactive map available on mobile'), so only a single demo marker is visible and marker-tap-to-dock, cluster, and 'active' fill inversion could NOT be exercised end-to-end via web automation — those behaviours were validated via code review only and must be spot-checked on device/Expo Go by the main agent.

minor.issue: Pre-existing flaky race-condition test in test_phase_d3_discovery_pipeline.py::TestBulkJobs::test_concurrent_limit_returns_429 — fails intermittently when suite is run in parallel with default addopts, passes reliably on isolated re-run. Not related to this iteration.

issues: react-native-maps is web-stubbed to a static image with the caption 'Interactive map available on mobile'. Only one demo marker (marker-residential, ₦145M) renders — full clustering / marker-tap / docked-card cannot be verified on web preview. Expected for Expo web, but flag to main agent that end-to-end validation of marker interactions requires a native/Expo Go run.

react_native_issues.issue: Console shows 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' RN 0.76+ deprecation warnings — not introduced by this iteration but should be tracked. Reference: repeating across screens.
'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing.' — expected on web, no action needed.

code_review_findings: PropertyMarker.tsx testID template `marker-${slug}${active ? '-active' : ''}${hot ? '-hot' : ''}` is correct — slug is normalised through normalizePropertyType, so raw registry values like 'duplex'/'penthouse' still map to residential/apartment.

formatMarkerPrice in theme.ts covers rent → /yr and shortlet → /mo; 'lease' listing_type is treated as sale (no suffix) — potential minor inconsistency because MapDockedCard.tsx line 177 treats lease like rent (/yr). If backend can return listing_type='lease', markers will show no suffix while the card will. Minor, worth aligning if 'lease' is a real value in the corpus.

MapDockedCard.tsx uses '/night' for shortlet in the card price suffix (line 178) but formatMarkerPrice uses '/mo' for shortlet on the marker (theme.ts:169). Both are defensible but should be consistent per product spec ('₦450K/mo' was cited in the review request).
Marker verified badge correctly overlays without replacing the border colour (gold when active, green idle). Shield hidden on 'sold' status — correct.
Legend sheet still uses testID `legend-{slug}` (LayerPickerSheet.tsx:120) — matches acceptance criteria.
action_items: OPTIONAL: Align shortlet suffix — MapDockedCard says '/night' while marker uses '/mo'. Review spec called out '/mo' for shortlet markers explicitly; pick one and reuse across marker + card.
OPTIONAL: Extend formatMarkerPrice to also append '/yr' for listing_type === 'lease' to match MapDockedCard behaviour.

OPTIONAL: main agent should visually confirm on Expo Go (native) that: (a) marker-tap flips fill to dark ink while keeping the type-colour border; (b) multiple marker slugs render (apartment, land, commercial etc.) using the 10-property corpus; (c) MapDockedCard shows the coloured typeChip; (d) PropertyCard row variant renders the 4px rowLeftAccent bar. These cannot be verified via Expo web preview because react-native-maps is stubbed to a static placeholder.
OPTIONAL: address the recurring 'shadow*' / 'pointerEvents' RN 0.76 deprecation console warnings when convenient — not caused by this iteration.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (of what could be exercised on web preview)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing 10-property demo seed and demo@amass.africa credentials.

All testID contracts (marker-{slug}, legend-{slug}) are honoured. Backend contract unchanged; /api/properties feeds only db.properties. Regression suite (Phase-D) is 134 pass / 1 skipped with one known flaky race-condition test in test_phase_d3_discovery_pipeline.py that passes on isolated re-run. Login flow: skip onboarding by navigating directly to /login; testIDs are login-email, login-password, login-submit-button. Layer sheet opens via fab-layers testID.
